title.narrative: Fiscal Consolidation Program for Guatemala
Programa de Consolidacion Fiscal para Guatemala

description.narrative: El objetivo de este programa es aumentar la sostenibilidad fiscal de Guatemala, a travs del incremento de los ingresos fiscales, el fortalecimiento de los mecanismos de control del endeudamiento nacional y municipal, y aumentar la calidad del gasto en un marco fiscal de mediano plazo.

The objective of this program is to improve the fiscal sustainability of Guatemala, through increased tax revenues, the strengthening of control mechanisms of national and municipal debt, and increase the quality of spending in a medium-term fiscal framework.
